symptom: a pluggable widget with an optional datasource X and a textTemplate bound to it (dataSource="X"), both unset: check and exec pass, mx check 11.14 reports CE0463 "The definition of this widget has changed"; `mx update-widgets` changes only that TextTemplate, empty Forms$ClientTemplate -> null (mendixlabs/mxcli#1745)
cause: the builder nulls a TextTemplate only when the widget's editorConfig hides it (#574) or an item rule does (#1198); a template bound to an unset data source is a third case, decided by the widget.xml binding, not by editorConfig — and the binding was already loaded as PropertyTypeIDEntry.DataSourceProperty
insight: The reporter's widget is unpublished, and no widget an app ships has a TOP-LEVEL textTemplate bound to an OPTIONAL datasource (Gallery, Timeline and TreeNode bind to required ones; HTMLElement's is hidden by editorConfig outside repeat mode). A probe .mpk is a few lines: package.xml, the widget XML pair from the issue, an empty .mjs — `mxcli widget extract --mpk` then makes it authorable. Measured on fresh 11.14.0: base 3 x CE0463 (one per page), fix 0, and the reporter's control (data source set, template unset) keeps its empty template in both. Only unset templates are nulled; authored text is the statement's.
